prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Dustmere: the dry bed of a vanished lake, dust in the air, an old shoreline and a last well. A spare, resilient melody with plucked strings and soft hand drum. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 1 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
